payoutCycle.description: Funded traders can request on-demand USDC payouts 24/7 with a $50 minimum. After Kraken's September 2025 acquisition, withdrawals run on Kraken rails rather than a queued approval desk.

channels.name: USDC
channels.notes: Stablecoin payouts; network fees are separate.

warnings: Crypto markets trade 24/7 — daily loss and max-drawdown limits still apply overnight and on weekends.
The Breakout Terminal is the primary interface; there is no MT5 or TradingView integration.
Profit split starts at 80% and can be upgraded to 90% at checkout; confirm the live checkout rate before buying.

faqs.question: What is Breakout?
faqs.answer: Breakout is a crypto-native proprietary trading firm launched in November 2023. It was acquired by Kraken in September 2025. Traders evaluate on the Breakout Terminal with simulated capital from $5,000 to $200,000, then request on-demand USDC payouts if they stay inside the daily-loss and max-drawdown limits.

seo.title: What is Breakout? | Crypto Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Breakout is a Kraken-owned crypto prop firm with on-demand USDC payouts and a dedicated trading terminal.

faqs.question: How do Breakout payouts work?
faqs.answer: Funded traders can withdraw any amount from $50 upward on demand, 24/7, in USDC. There is no minimum trading-day wait after the first funded trade. Processing typically completes the same day on Kraken's infrastructure.

seo.title: Breakout Payout Speed and Methods
seo.metaDescription: Breakout pays on-demand USDC from a $50 minimum with no trading-day wait after you are funded.

faqs.question: What evaluation rules does Breakout use?
faqs.answer: Breakout offers 1-Step Turbo, Pro and Classic plus a 2-Step Classic. Headline targets are around 9–12% profit with 3–8% drawdown depending on the plan. The firm markets no consistency rule, no time limit and no minimum trading days — you still cannot breach the published daily loss or max drawdown.

seo.title: Breakout Evaluation Rules Explained
seo.metaDescription: See Breakout's 1-step and 2-step profit targets, drawdown limits, and what is not restricted.

faqs.question: Which platforms and markets does Breakout support?
faqs.answer: Trading runs on the Breakout Terminal with Kraken exchange liquidity (historically marketed with Bybit depth before the acquisition). The product is crypto-first — dozens of perpetual pairs rather than MT4/MT5 FX books. Markets are open 24/7.

seo.title: Breakout Trading Platforms and Markets
seo.metaDescription: Breakout uses its own terminal on Kraken liquidity for 24/7 crypto perpetuals, not MT5.

faqs.question: What profit split does Breakout pay?
faqs.answer: The default funded split is 80% to the trader. A 90% split is sold as a checkout add-on. Confirm the live checkout price and whether the upgrade is refundable before you buy.

seo.title: Breakout Profit Split
seo.metaDescription: Breakout starts at an 80% trader split with an optional 90% checkout upgrade.

pros: Kraken-owned crypto infrastructure and on-demand USDC payouts

cons: Crypto-only — no classic FX or futures book
